title: x-sdkgen-allof-resolution
description: Audited, per-property resolution metadata for a Schema Object's strict allOf intersection. Only valid as a direct property of a Schema Object that declares an array-valued 'allOf'. Every digest in this extension is computed over the *resolved structural form* of a schema node: canonical JSON (object keys sorted lexicographically, no insignificant whitespace, JSON numbers rendered from the parsed value) of the node with every '$ref' replaced, transitively, by the content of its target. Each '$ref' resolves against the document that declared it (external references use their own base URI). A '$ref' whose canonical target id '<documentUri>#<jsonPointer>' is already being resolved on the current path is a cycle and is substituted with the token object {"$sdkgen-allof-resolution-cycle": "<documentUri>#<jsonPointer>"}; an unresolvable '$ref' is substituted with {"$sdkgen-allof-resolution-unresolved-ref": "<raw reference>"}. Keywords declared alongside a '$ref' apply conjunctively, as in JSON Schema: the resolved form keeps the target's keywords AND the siblings, and on a key conflict both declarations are preserved, wrapped as the token object {"$sdkgen-allof-resolution-conjunction": [<target value>, <sibling value>]}. Because these digests cover the resolved target and every shadowed keyword, mutating a referenced schema without changing the '$ref' text still shifts the digest and fails the audit closed. Reproduce the canonical form via the same key-sorted UTF-8 canonical JSON described here; a failed source binding reports each candidate branch's expected digest.

properties.description: Map of property name to the audited resolution for that property within the intersection.

strategy.description: The only supported inheritance-style resolution strategy: the selected branch's property schema supersedes the others in the intersection.

source.description: Identifies exactly one allOf branch (by '$ref' text or by resolved inline digest) and pins the resolved schema of the named property on that branch.

ref.description: Selects the branch whose literal 'allOf' '$ref' text equals this value. The property is then located by following that branch's '$ref'/alias chain; when more than one chain layer declares the property, all layers must agree on a single resolved form.

inlineSchemaSha256.description: Selects the (single) inline allOf branch whose resolved structural form has this SHA-256 digest. 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

propertySchemaSha256.description: SHA-256 of the resolved structural form of the named property's schema on the selected branch. 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Must match the current source or adaptation fails closed.
